_comment: Scheme Certification Authority (CA) public keys used for offline CDA verification. These are published by the payment schemes (Visa, Mastercard, etc.) and are NOT bundled with the app. Add the key TapRead reports it needs (it prints the required RID + index). 'rid' = first 5 bytes of the AID (10 hex chars); 'index' = CA Public Key Index (EMV tag 8F, 2 hex chars); 'modulus' and 'exponent' are hex (no spaces). Example entry shape below under 'keys' (currently empty).
